concepts.gloss_en: salt; the 'salt' that sweetens the bitterness of livelihood, tied to the covenant of salt (brit melach)

members.note: salt — melach ha-mamtik merirut; brit melach olam

concepts.gloss_en: 'send' (imperative shalach), i.e. charity — 'shalach lachmecha al pnei ha-mayim'

members.note: verb 'send' representing tzedakah; entirely different root/word from מלח (salt)

notes: Not the same concept — מלח (salt) and שלח (send/charity) are different roots and referents; mechanical grouping was on consonant-shape similarity only. Kept fully separate.
